ref_entities: build a MaskedTokenProcessor to tokenize text with BERT-style random masking for language modeling
create a BertTokenizer to convert text into BERT input IDs, masks, and segment IDs
build a MultiSentenceBertTokenizer to tokenize multiple sentences separately and fuse them into a single tensor
create a RobertaTokenizer to tokenize text using RoBERTa special tokens and encoding format
build a VinVLTextTokenizer to tokenize text with contrastive corruption support for vision-language pretraining
build a Compose transform pipeline that chains multiple detection transforms for image preprocessing
create a Normalize processor that normalizes images and converts boxes to normalized cxcywh format
test the RandomSizeCrop class to randomly crop images and adjust bounding box targets
refactor the RandomResize class to resize images to random sizes while scaling bounding boxes
review the RandomHorizontalFlip class and hflip function for horizontally flipping images and adjusting boxes
build a python module to preprocess images for Faster R-CNN detection using FRCNNPreprocess with config
create a ResizeShortestEdge augmentation that resizes images by their shortest edge within a size range
test the img_tensorize function to load an image from a file path or URL into a numpy array
review the FRCNNPreprocess call method that normalizes, pads, and resizes images for model input
summarize the FRCNNPreprocess pad method that pads variable-sized images to uniform dimensions for batching
create a function that crops a video tensor at specified spatial coordinates with given height and width
create a function that center crops a video tensor to a specified output size tuple
create a function that horizontally flips a video tensor along the width dimension
create a function that resizes a video tensor using bilinear interpolation to a target size
create a function that normalizes a video tensor using provided mean and standard deviation lists
build a TorchvisionTransforms processor from an OmegaConf config to compose torchvision transforms into a pipeline
create a GrayScaleTo3Channels processor that tiles a single channel grayscale tensor into 3 channels
build a ResizeShortest processor that resizes images by their shortest side within min and max size bounds
create a NormalizeBGR255 processor to convert RGB to BGR255, normalize, and optionally pad images to a fixed size
build a VILTImageProcessor that resizes, converts to tensor, handles grayscale, and normalizes images for VILT models
build a vocab processor that converts text tokens to padded index tensors using a vocabulary file
build an EvalAI answer processor that normalizes answers by stripping punctuation and expanding contractions
build a VQA answer processor that computes answer scores using the standard VQA accuracy formula
build a simple sentence processor that tokenizes raw text into word tokens for downstream use
build an M4C answer processor that matches answers to vocabulary and OCR tokens for iterative decoding
build a VideoTransforms pipeline from an OmegaConf config to compose multiple video transforms
create a VideoRandomCrop processor with a given size to randomly crop video frames
create a VideoToTensor processor to convert video data to a normalized float tensor
